notes.title: Thank you for walking with us through Early Access.
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]We’ve finally completed [b]all endings of the Antonio route[/b].[/p][p]This is the [b]first game I’ve ever made[/b], and I know it’s far from perfect. There are many places that feel immature, many things I wish I could’ve done better. Early Access was never meant to be a finished version — there were always going to be changes along the way.[/p][p]Back in May, when our second producer left the team, I became the [b]sole developer[/b] behind this project. That means I haven’t been able to reply to every message, or keep up with every platform, or run proper promotions.[/p][p][b]But you stayed.[/b][/p][p]You played the EA version, left comments, shared it with friends…
You saw something in this story, believed it was worth continuing, and kept waiting.
And for that — I’m deeply grateful.[/p][p]To me, EA players are not just “players.”
[b]You are the ones who witnessed this story grow, and watched me grow alongside it.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🍂 Upcoming Plans: Autumn Sale, Fixes & What's Next[/h3][p]We’ll be joining the [b]Steam Autumn Sale on September 30th[/b], and before then, we’ll release a small patch to fix known bugs in the Antonio route.[/p][p]After that, we’ll finalize the production schedule for:[/p][list][*][p]the [b]Glossary  system[/b][/p][/*][*][p]several [b]bonus side stories[/b][/p][/*][*][p]and the long-awaited [b]Mika route[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]We also plan to write a few devlogs to share the small, sometimes ridiculous things that happened along the way — the moments that made us laugh, or almost give up, or suddenly find a new idea that changed everything.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🗺 A note for English-speaking players[/h3][p]I haven’t had the time or energy to properly promote this game on English platforms.
There’s been no fancy trailer, no press coverage, and barely any social media in English.
And yet, [b]you still found it[/b].[/p][p]Somehow, somewhere, you discovered this story.
And you stayed.[/p][p]That means more than I can say.[/p][p]The [b]English version of Antonio’s major update[/b] is scheduled for [b]November[/b]. This will include the complete storyline along with the glossary feature to help you piece together the world’s mysteries.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Domus Aurea[/b][/p]

notes.title: The English version of Antonio’s major update is scheduled for November.
notes.content: [p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]The Antonio route update is almost ready. We’re currently fixing the final bugs and polishing stability to make sure the experience is smooth for everyone.[/p][p]For this reason, the update will be released on [b]Tuesday, September 23[/b], instead of this Friday. Thank you for your patience and understanding—we want to deliver the story to you in the best possible form.[/p][p]For our international community: the [b]English version of Antonio’s major update[/b] is scheduled for [b]November[/b]. This will include the complete storyline along with the glossary feature to help you piece together the world’s mysteries.[/p][p][/p][p]Domus Aurea[/p]

notes.title: Major Update: Antonio Route
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]We’ve officially begun updating the [b]Antonio route[/b]. Chapter by chapter, the story will unfold, and the full route will be completed on [b]September 19[/b].[/p][p]For our international community: the [b]English version of Antonio’s major update[/b] is scheduled for [b]November[/b]. This will include the complete storyline along with the glossary feature to help you piece together the world’s mysteries.[/p][p]Thank you to all Early Access players for your support and companionship. Every comment, every bit of feedback, reminds us why we’re building this world. I truly believe we will reach the true ending of this story together. ❤️[/p][p][b]Domus Aurea[/b][/p]

notes.title: Antonio Route Play Guide
notes.content: [h3]⚠️ [b]Content Warning[/b][/h3][p]This update contains strong adult themes which may be disturbing to some players, including but not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Violence and crime depictions[/p][/*][*][p]Sexual violence and suggestive content[/p][/*][*][p]Religious horror imagery[/p][/*][*][p]Shocking visual and audio effects[/p][/*][*][p]Ethical controversies[/p][/*][*][p]Moral dilemmas and depictions of human darkness[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 This game is [b]not recommended for minors[/b]. Please carefully consider your personal comfort level before playing.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Playtime & Recommendation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reaching [b]any ending[/b] in Antonio’s route takes about [b]20 hours[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Completing [b]all endings[/b] takes about [b]25 hours[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Since the game is still in [b]Early Access[/b], after this major update we [b]strongly recommend resetting your game from the main menu settings and starting again from Chapter One[/b]. (This will reset all collected progress.)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Story Experience & Hints[/b][/h3][p]Reaching a final ending means you have made the right choices through every scheme and act of malice, and successfully inherited the legacy.[/p][p]In this story:[/p][list][*][p][b]You are not a detective[/b], and no one will solve the mysteries for you.[/p][/*][*][p]Every ending and every stamp contains fragments of truth.[/p][/*][*][p]If you enjoy reviewing details and connecting clues across different routes, you will eventually clear the fog and uncover reality.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Mild Spoiler Guidance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Antonio’s secrets are tied to the endings [b]“The Sister”[/b], [b]“The One”[/b], and [b]“Pugno”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The truth behind the school’s mysteries is hidden in the [b]two secret endings[/b], and unlocking the stamp [b]“The Truth Revealed”[/b] will also provide vital clues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How to unlock “The Truth Revealed”[/b]: You must discover a certain secret about Solomon in Chapter Four, then meet Mrs. Merrick again in the ending [b]“The Successor”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In the endings [b]“The Sister”[/b] and one hidden route, you will reunite with an unexpected character who brings further secrets and unresolved threads—these will be addressed in the upcoming [b]Mika route[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Full Antonio Route Coming in September
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear players,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]I’m Dan, the lead developer of this game.
We’re currently working on Chapter 4, and with this post, I’d like to speak to you more personally—about what’s been happening behind the scenes, and what lies ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, a lot has changed in my life.
I moved to a new home.
I ended a three-year relationship.
My co-developer, Imiýta, left the team due to personal reasons.
A close family member was diagnosed with cancer and underwent surgery.[/p][p][/p][p]And yet, through it all, I never stopped working on this project. In a way, this game has become my emotional anchor. What keeps me going isn’t just passion—it’s your anticipation.
It’s every comment, every walkthrough, every fan illustration and piece of merch that reminds me: this world we’re building matters to someone out there.[/p][p][/p][p]We are still on track to release the [b]full Antonio route[/b] on [b]September 12[/b] in Simplified Chinese. It will include [b]four main endings and two hidden ones[/b]. This is a complete, self-contained story that will reveal the secrets behind Arenda’s family—and the unspeakable truths hidden within the school.[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, the [b]English and Traditional Chinese versions[/b] will not be ready by then. After the August update, I plan to take a short break to rest and recover. Our current goal is to release the [b]English version by November[/b], alongside the [b]glossary system[/b]—a new feature to help players better follow the characters, lore, and narrative threads in this intricate world. In the meantime, we’ll be fixing minor bugs based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking further ahead, we plan to begin [b]Mika’s route[/b] in the [b]first half of 2026[/b]. This will be a brand-new storyline, equal in scale to Antonio’s arc, and it will delve into deeper secrets and reveal the hidden structure of this world.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, I want to say:
Being able to make this project is already a privilege. But even more so, it’s been a gift to meet all of you through it.
Thank you for loving the first two chapters.
So far, we’ve received [b]zero negative reviews[/b], and the responses you’ve left show a deep understanding of the story. That, more than anything, is the greatest reward for me as a writer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for buying this game.
Thank you for recommending it to your friends.
I’ll continue doing my best to bring you stories that are rich, dark, and meaningful.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you in August.[/p]

notes.title: Major Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you for your continued support of Malleus Cocconum: the Heiress! We'd like to take this opportunity to share our current development progress and what lies ahead in future updates.

[h2]Current Progress[/h2]
We are now focusing on Chapter 3 of the story. This chapter will introduce branching paths, hidden routes and scenes, as well as more animation and interactive elements.
Here’s our tentative schedule:
•Chapter 3: Estimated completion in May
•Chapter 4: Estimated completion in June
•Chapter 5 + Antonio’s 4 main endings + 2 hidden endings + optional side route ending: Estimated completion in July

Once you complete all of Antonio’s endings and hidden routes, you will gradually uncover:
•The secrets behind Arenda’s family
•The truth behind the strange occurrences at the school
[h3]We’ve chosen to release the full Antonio route all at once, rather than updating chapter by chapter, because we want players to experience the complete emotional arc and narrative structure in one uninterrupted flow. Antonio’s storyline is self-contained and tightly constructed—we hope this major update will provide a cohesive, immersive, and deeply memorable experience.[/h3]
The major update is scheduled for August, and we will adjust the game’s price before its release to reflect the expanded content and narrative depth. Players who have already purchased the game will not be affected—thank you for your early support!

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
After Antonio’s route is fully released, we will begin work on Mika’s route. This is a brand-new story branch that runs parallel to the mainline narrative, offering a different perspective on the world and revealing deeper truths and intersections of fate.
Additionally, in response to your feedback, we plan to introduce a Glossary System once Antonio’s route is complete. This will help players better navigate the game’s complex lore, character relationships, literary references, and hidden narrative structures.

Finally
We know waiting can be hard, and we deeply appreciate every bit of anticipation and support you've given us. We will continue refining every detail of the story—so that it lives up to the trust and love you’ve shown.
Thank you for your patience, and please continue looking forward to the unfolding of this world.

Domus Aurea

notes.title: First EA Update
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players for your feedback—your support makes this game even better!
This update addresses multiple bugs and introduces new features to improve your gameplay experience.

[h2]Update Details[/h2]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
1. Fixed typos in both Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese versions.
2. Language recognition improvement: The game will now detect the system language and allow adjustments via the Steam library. [i]If your game still starts in the wrong language, please select the fourth option in the main menu to change it and let us know.[/i]
3. Fixed Quick Menu disappearing issue and added Immersive Mode (you can choose to display the menu only when hovering or keep it always visible). [i]This feature requires a new game start and does not work with old save files.[/i]
4. Fixed occasional text button movement in the Simplified Chinese main menu when hovering.
5. Fixed an issue where Itch.io players & offline Steam players couldn't unlock Steam achievements due to persistent data conflicts.

[b]Optimizations & New Features[/b]
6. UI Enhancements:
[list]
[*] Added fade-in effects when entering the main menu, starting a new game, loading a game, or exiting replay mode for a smoother transition.
[*] Separated the main menu preference page from the in-game settings for better accessibility.
[/list]
7. New “Memory Reset” Feature (Delete Persistent Data):
[list]
[*] This allows players to wipe all collectible progress (stamps, endings, paintings, in-game achievement pop-ups, and future glossaries).
[*] All obtained stats will be erased, letting you unlock everything again from scratch.
[/list]
8. New shortcut: Scroll up with the mouse wheel to access History (previous dialogue).
9. Character sprite adjustments: fixed spirits for Marie, Johanna, and Jessica.
10. New Special Thanks section added to recognize our amazing Itch.io supporters!

[h2]MacBook Launch Issue Explanation[/h2]
Due to macOS requiring all Steam developers to notarize their games, our game cannot currently be launched directly from the Steam library. At this time, the game has not yet been notarized, meaning MacBook users will need to start the game manually.

[b]How to Run the Game?[/b]
MacBook users can still play the game, but you will need to launch it manually from Local Files (please follow the guide below).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45085319/424cfb63886e7878763af7af5914288807e0ddc2.png[/img]
❗ Please do not search for the game in Finder—this method will not allow the game to start.

[b]Known Limitations[/b]
Since the game cannot be launched via Steam, playtime will not be recorded, and Steam achievements cannot be unlocked.
This issue does not affect gameplay or save functionality.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
We plan to complete notarization before the full release, allowing MacBook users to launch the game directly from Steam, track playtime, and unlock achievements. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Guidelines for Recording and Creative Content
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing [i]Malleus Cocconum: the Heiress[/i] and for the love you’ve shown us!

We wholeheartedly welcome you to share your passion for this game through video commentary, fan art, written works, and other creative expressions! These creations mean the world to us and help introduce the game to even more people.

To protect the game’s content, [u][b]we do not encourage uploading unoriginal, pure walkthrough recordings.[/b][/u] If we notice such videos on platforms (e.g., YouTube or Bilibili), we will contact you to request their removal.

If your creations contain spoilers about the game’s story, we kindly ask that you wait at least one month after major updates before publishing them, so as not to impact the exploration experience of other players.

If you’d like to recommend [i]Malleus Cocconum: the Heiress[/i] on social media, [b]we encourage you to share posts, screenshots, or other creative expressions of your love for the game instead.[/b]

Thank you once again for your support!

Your enthusiasm and passion are our greatest motivation!

If you’re willing, please share this game with more friends!

Domus Aurea

notes.title: Known Issues and Fixes Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for your love and support for [i]Malleus Cocconum: the Heiress[/i]!
We have received some valuable feedback from players, and here are the bugs we've identified along with our plans to fix them.

Bug Overview

1.Default Language Setting Issue:
For English-speaking players, the game defaults to Simplified Chinese. [u][b]Until this issue is resolved, please manually select the fourth option in the main menu to switch the language.[/b][/u]

2.MacBook Launch and Achievement Issues:
Some MacBook users have experienced the following problems due to Steam mistakenly identifying the game as a 32-bit program:
[list]
[*] The game cannot be launched from the Steam Library (requires launching from the local files).
[*] Steam achievements cannot be unlocked, and playtime is not recorded.
[*] Unfortunately, we are unable to resolve this issue directly, but we have reported it to Valve and are awaiting their response.
[/list]

3.Typos in Simplified Chinese Text:
We will thoroughly review and correct all typos in the Simplified Chinese version of the game.

4.Mouse Hover Issue in the Main Menu (Simplified Chinese Version):
In the Simplified Chinese version, main menu buttons shift position when hovered over with the mouse. 

[b]We plan to fix all these issues by March.[/b]

Thank you again for supporting our game! If you have any additional questions or suggestions, please feel free to share them on the Steam Community.

Domus Aurea
